we provide an algorithm for computing the Hermite form of an n × n polynomial matrix over the rationals that runs in time polynomial in n, the degree of the polynomial matrix, and the maximum degree of the coefficients of the polynomials.

the following problems are solvable in polynomial time over the rationals: finding a triangular canonical form of a matrix over the rationals using unimodulare column operations, finding a diagonal canonical form of a polynomial over the rationals, and finding the invariant factors (or the Hermite normal form) of a matrix of rational entries.

(i) the Hermite form can be computed in polynomial-time, and (ii) the Smith canonical form can be computed by first computing the Hermite form and then performing a sequence of unimodular row operations.
